PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday JULY 11, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Smith and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar
7A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of June 13, 2019
7A
8. Public Hearings
8A. General Plan Amendment 19-001 / Zone Change 19-001 / Planned Development 19-001 / Tentative Tract Map 82636 / Conditional Use Permit 19-002 / Site Plan Review 19-003
Coyne Development, Applicant
The proposed project consists of a 308-unit apartment complex, 36-unit townhome development, and approximately 43,000 square feet of retail/commercial development on a vacant site (Site Plan Review 19-003). The proposed project also includes General Plan Amendment 19-001 and Zone Change 19-001 to allow changes to the land use designation and zone to accommodate the residential components of the project, Planned Development 19-001 is a request for approval of a document that allows flexibility of development standards, Tentative Tract Map 82636 which proposes to subdivide the lot into 42 lots and Conditional Use Permit 19-002 to allow the sale of beer and wine (Alcoholic Beverage Control License Type 20 - Off-sale Beer and Wine) within a proposed grocery store in the commercial component of the site.
Project Planner: Perry Banner, Contract Planner
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-027 recommending City Council approval of GPA 19-001 and ZC 19-001, approving PD 19-001, TTM 82636, CUP 19-002, and SPR 19-003 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program prepared for the project.
8A
8B. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 19-004
York Palmdale Properties, LLC, Applicant
A request to amend Palmdale Municipal Code Section 17.55.050 to allow religious assembly uses within the C-5 (Service Commercial) zone. Project Planner: Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-029 recommending City Council approval of ZOA 19-004 and find that the legislative act is exempt from environmental review.
8B
8C. Zoning Ordinance Amendment 19-005
Bouma USA, Applicant
A request to amend Palmdale Municipal Code Section 17.86.040.C.3, 4 and 5 to allow for an exception to the fence height requirements within all City zones, as required for safety, if determined by the Planning Director. Project Planner: Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-030 recommending City Council approval of ZOA 19-005 and find that the legislative act is exempt from environmental review.
8C
8. Public Hearings
9. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
